source: gc_lib.PAL / ALPHA / MATSPEC and gc_mat.CLASSES via export_colony_glb.py
note: rgb is linear. Class parameters are the ones gc_mat._surface reads. emission is the palette's game value, not a calibrated light output.

decal_scorch.note: procedural decal with soft alpha in Blender; flat translucent stand-in

decal_tracks.note: procedural decal with soft alpha in Blender; flat translucent stand-in

terrain_mars.note: terrain shader: albedo and masks come from vertex data (COLOR_0, UV, UV2)

terrain_basalt.note: procedural rock in Blender; flat stand-in inside the albedo range 0.08-0.12 stated in gc_terrain.rock_material

terrain_outer.note: terrain mesh without a colour attribute; flat mean of the tiles' gc_alb (1419023 vertices)
